concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a large healing potion, the bigger sibling of the small potion in the second reference image (same glass, same glowing teal-green liquid, same art style). A tall flask whose lower body is wrapped in woven tan wicker basketry, with an arched woven wicker carry handle over the top, glowing teal-green healing liquid visible in the upper glass, and a big chunky cork stopper. Flat bottom so it stands upright. About 0.48 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
